in_marathi.name: Ashaana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Hope, Wish, Expectation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashaana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashaana is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'asha' meaning hope, wish, or expectation. In Hindu mythology, Asha is the goddess of truth and righteousness. The name Ashaana signifies the belief that hope and truth are intertwined and can lead to a fulfilling life.
